Bank of England cuts interest rates to 4.5%

The Bank of England cut its benchmark interest rate by 25 basis points to 4.5% on Tuesday, the central bank said in a statement after its policy meeting.

The Monetary Policy Committee said inflation had continued to ease over the summer and that it expected price growth to return to its target next year.

Economists had widely expected the move, which follows a similar decision by other central banks earlier in the month.
